items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Do you know a clarinet player named Buddy Green or Bubba Green? I met him yesterday.

ctx.x: I mean, I mean, this guy would be stand up talking like this and say, Yeah, man, you know. Like that all the time he'd do that. I said, man, what's the matter, please? No, man. See, I just, I can't have that. I didn't do that. But I don't see him do it the last time I saw him a couple of times.
No, he's gotten too old, I guess. Maybe so. Too tired to do that now, I guess. Do you know a clarinet player named Buddy Green or Bubba Green? I met him yesterday.
